content: warren-be12 (#420): reap bookkeeping commits in src/runs/reap/stage.ts path-limit with 'git commit --only -- <pathspecs>' (.plot/ for plot state; the SEEDS_COMMITTABLE_FILES-derived .seeds/issues.jsonl + .seeds/plans.jsonl for seeds state) so pre-staged unrelated files in the workspace index are never swept into the chore(warren) commit. The seeds staged-delta guard (git diff --cached --quiet) is narrowed to the same two pathspecs for symmetry.

name: tighten structural dep interfaces to drop caller casts
description: When a structurally-typed dependency seam loosens a parameter to `unknown` (e.g. DispatchAutoPlanRunsInput.planRuns.create: (input: unknown) => ...), retype it to the real input type (CreatePlanRunInput from src/db/repos/plan-runs.ts) and delete the caller's `as unknown as` cast in pipeline.ts. It typechecks because the real PlanRunsRepo.create is structurally assignable: its richer CreatePlanRunResult return is assignable to the minimal { planRun: { id: string } } subset via return-type covariance, and identical params need no variance relaxation. Test fakes that still declare `input: unknown` keep compiling via parameter contravariance (unknown is a supertype of CreatePlanRunInput), so no fake rewrite is needed. Prefer import type to avoid any runtime import cycle into src/db/repos/.

content: Agents working in warren-on-warren must stage code with a scoped 'git add -- <pathspec>' and never 'git add -A' / 'git commit -a'. warren seeds .canopy/agent.json (a constitution-protected path) into the workspace with the effective provider/model; sweeping it into a commit flips the tracked builtin-agent envelope and blocks Article IX auto-merge (warren-aced). .seeds/issues.jsonl + .seeds/plans.jsonl are status bookkeeping that reap commits separately as 'chore(warren): seeds state'. The agent's PR should carry only its intended code diff; the prior cleanup-batch commits (#533-#541) all follow this two-commit shape.

description: Dogfood session 2026-07-17 surfaced four reap/dispatch reliability bugs, all fixed same-day by warren runs: (1) warren-495d — in-pod finalize timeout reported run succeeded + destroyed workspace, silently losing agent commits (PR #596); (2) warren-8d95 — workspace seeding overwrote tracked .canopy/agent.json, sweeping it into PRs and tripping the Article IX automerge guard on every broad commit; fixed by seed-reset before branch_push (PR #599) — note fixes only take effect after the GKE CD rollout completes, so runs dispatched immediately after a merge race the deploy and still run old reap code; (3) warren-3806 — plan-run child seeds were not deterministically closed on child PR merge (PR #607); (4) warren-89b0 — intentional no-commit runs misclassified as dropped_commit and host-side seedIdClosed fired on failed runs (PR #608).
resolution: All four fixed and merged same-day via dispatched warren runs: PRs #596, #599, #607, #608 on k8s-migration; verified live (PR #601 onward shows seededArtifact=false, plan-run children auto-close from #607).

description: The predicted warren-1899 sweep happened: on the stale 0.12.2 live instance the control plane seeds .canopy/agent.json into every workspace, and PR #667's 'git add -A' committed it into main.
resolution: git rm .canopy/agent.json pushed to main in the 2026-07-30 dogfood wrap-up commit; until 0.13.0 deploys, check every run PR's file list for .canopy/agent.json before merge.

description: A seeds close was silently lost to duplicate-row resolution: warren-e274 existed as both an open row (filed on main) and a closed row (from its fix PR #665); later agent PRs (#668, #669) resolved the duplicate by deleting the CLOSED row, reopening a fixed issue. Also learned: sd close run from a git worktree writes to the MAIN repo checkout (worktree resolution), so transplant rows deliberately when committing from a worktree.
resolution: Re-closed warren-e274 citing PR #665; at every pipeline wrap-up verify each touched seed's status on origin (git show origin/main:.seeds/issues.jsonl) and re-close with evidence; filed warren-3886 for the structural dedupe fix.
